ROUND 1 security PASS for PR #262 at f9cb2d15c8b0adab09d0dcb46182fcd3e19c466d. This publishes the held original-request review after replacement-head confirmation.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

The security-review specialist found no vulnerabilities in the original affdf009bf6f79d05d4e4234716cf6159b406506 review, scoped to nice19.sh argument/exec quoting, ps and numeric handling, executable/PATH resolution, changed recipe/shared-build integration and public-source hygiene. Publication was held as requested while the coder rebased.

I directly verified the replacement range-diff against origin/main, which resolves to the stated 4c899c0ac5400ea075bb3bb83199054283a5cbc4. Commit 1 changes only surrounding context, commit 2 is identical (=), and commit 3 changes exactly one recipe line: update-copilot now invokes harness/scripts/nice19.sh instead of bare nice -n 19, retaining fixed node and script arguments. That line introduces no new expansion or argument parsing. No unchanged-code re-review was needed; the held security result carries forward to this exact head under C33 trusted-user assumptions.

The reviewer-owned R257-002 ps-failure behavior remains the named C34 follow-up described in the replacement packet, not a new security finding or reopened blocker from this confirmation.

Validation: exact detached HEAD verified clean. just pr-freeze 262 returned FINAL/exit 0 with remote/GitHub agreement, main base, CLEAN merge, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. No local tests, builds, cargo commands, dependency installations, updater/deploy execution, credential-file reads or global-config changes were performed. The coder-reported 47 tests were not independently rerun.

Known limit: static security review plus rebase/one-line-delta and CI/finality verification, not runtime niceness/signal proof or live-fleet cost measurement.
